name: motif_entry
description:
Read a lexical entry. Reads an entry from the current Baseline by entry id or sense id: the headword and every sense with its glosses. A Proposal change names a sense by id; this says which entry and sense that is, with no Trial.
Command: lexical-entry. Agent class: Read.
Ids: Portable ids of entries or senses; a sense id reads the entry that owns it. At most 100.

ids.description: Ids of lexical entries or senses, such as a change's target. A sense id reads its entry.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: Page size for paged reads (findings, operations: default 10; proposals list: default 25), and the most list items in concise mode elsewhere (default 25).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
